get.description: You can retrieve shipment packages about every order placed by customers.

get.summary: Get Shipment Packages via Stream - getShipmentPackagesStream
get.description:
You can retrieve shipment packages for orders placed by customers using cursor-based pagination.
This method provides a more efficient and reliable way to fetch order packages compared to traditional page-number-based pagination.
Data is returned in a fixed sort order: lastModifiedDate newest to oldest (DESC).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of packages to return per request (default 50, maximum 200)

parameters.name: nextCursor
parameters.description: Opaque token used to fetch the next page. Must not be sent in the first request. Use the nextCursor value from the response as-is.

parameters.name: packageItemStatuses
parameters.description:
Filter by package item statuses. Multiple statuses can be sent separated by commas.
Valid values: Created, Picking, Invoiced, Shipped, Cancelled, Delivered, UnDelivered, Returned, UnSupplied, AtCollectionPoint, UnPacked, Awaiting

parameters.name: lastModifiedStartDate
parameters.description: Fetch packages modified after this date (Unix timestamp in milliseconds)

parameters.name: lastModifiedEndDate
parameters.description: Fetch packages modified before this date (Unix timestamp in milliseconds)

size.description: Number of packages in the current response

hasMore.description: Indicates whether more data is available. If true, the next page exists.

nextCursor.description: Cursor value to use for fetching the next page. Empty when hasMore is false.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid nextCursor value, invalid sellerId, cursor-filter mismatch

put.summary: Notify Deci and Box Quantity - updateBoxInfo
put.description: With this service, you can feed deci and box quantity for your order packages of UPS Cargo and CEVA Logistics companies.

After sending the order package, you can feed it with the cargo tracking link or phone number you have. After successfully submitting this request, the order will automatically switch to "Shipped" status.

trackingInfo.description: Cargo tracking link (if isPhoneNumber is false) or phone number (if isPhoneNumber is true)

put.summary: Manual Return by Package Id - manualReturnByPackageId
put.description: You can use this service for orders that are returned to your warehouse in the case of "shipped" status and cannot be delivered to the customer, and therefore cannot be transferred to "delivered" status.
Our sellers who ship their products to the authorized service should call this service.
This service is used to change the cargo provides of packages.
With this service, the "WarehouseId" field returned from the Picking Order Packages service will be updated.
